description: CODATA 2022 published rest masses (MeV/c²) for the electron, proton, neutron, deuteron, triton, helium-3 and helium-4. Values transcribed from the primary source: Mohr, Newell, Taylor & Tiesinga, 'CODATA recommended values of the fundamental physical constants: 2022', Rev. Mod. Phys. 97, 025002 (30 April 2025), vendored at library/revmodphys97025002pdf/RevModPhys.97.025002.pdf.pdf, pp. 45-48. CORRECTED 2026-08-09 (PR #4860): all seven literals previously held the CODATA-2018 values under a 'CODATA 2022' label — a ~1.3 ppb systematic straddle, first detected from internal inconsistency alone (bean qou-2an8) and then confirmed against this primary source. The old neutron entry was additionally the AME-derived value built on the stale proton, not the published direct determination. Per the QOU three-calibration discipline (content/quantum-observable-universe/braids-and-knots/three-calibration-inputs.md), only m_e (CAL-1) and Q_β (CAL-3) are calibration INPUTS to mass predictions; the m_p / m_n / m_D / m_T / m_3He / m_4He values are exposed for VALIDATION ONLY — to compare framework predictions against experiment. Importing them as upstream inputs to a mass / binding prediction violates the discipline and silently inflates the calibration count beyond the pre-approved 3.

parameters.data_source_q_beta: PDG 2024 free-neutron β-decay Q-value (consistent with AME 2020 mass-difference computation)

data.m_e_MeV_role: CAL-1 — leptonic mass scale (the framework's only direct mass-scale input).
data.m_p_MeV_role: VALIDATION-ONLY — framework prediction is m_p = |tr_M(p, q_0)| · E_0 with E_0 from CAL-3.
data.m_n_MeV_role: VALIDATION-ONLY — framework prediction is m_n = m_p + Q_β + m_e (3-input convention; see neutron-gap-probes-round3.witness.json).
data.m_D_MeV_role: VALIDATION-ONLY — framework prediction is m_D = (m_p + m_n)_pred + Binding(K=D); B(D) categorical via |tr_M(D)|, atomic-tr-m-mpfr-50dps.witness.json.

Q_beta_from_codata_minus_decomposition.tolerance_basis: combined CODATA σ of (m_e, m_p, m_n) under uncorrelated upper bound
Q_beta_from_codata_minus_decomposition.comment: Cross-check only. Q_β is the primary CAL-3 input (cal-3-q-beta.witness.json); this consistency check verifies CODATA refresh does not break the constraint.
